description:
Functional specifications/files: add focused Agent credential runtime integration tests covering real Connect mutation persistence, existing MutationEventWorker/NodeRouter/Agent receiver delivery, ServerManager invalidation and next LLM request.
Tests first: one Alice/Bob fixture validates personal replacement/revocation and unrelated-owner survival; one policy sequence validates optional→required→disabled and retained personal grant; one global replacement validates dependent invalidation and lazy recreation. Assert outgoing Authorization values and no eager LLM call.
Branches: Person grant replace/revoke, org grant replace, policy/config mutation, targeted versus conservative invalidation, lazy recreation, absent/invalid personal grant no fallback.
Mocking: only OpenAIStub at external provider boundary. Use actual persisted notification jobs selected by worker/event identity and moved to a unique test queue; never fabricate events or drain unrelated jobs. Use manager acknowledgments/process monitors, no sleeps.
Docs: update Agent/Engine test-contract prose only if behavior differs.
Action reuse: not applicable — tests orchestrate existing Connect mutation, Oban worker, NodeRouter, Agent receiver, ServerManager and Executor operations without production changes or new tools.
title: [zaq-jrg.41] Mutation-driven credential lifecycle HTTP integration coverage
